name: Zeitz Machz √Rhapsody
source:
No one knows what the future may hold. Just yesterday, Ais was going about her life enjoying it to the fullest. But out of nowhere, she suddenly finds herself confined alongside a strange girl called "Alice".

To make matters worse, neither of them remember anything prior to this incident. Just who is behind this? And why are they doing this?

Can you solve the mystery and uncover just what on earth happened to them? After all, this is just your average, run-of-the-mill Yuri game...right? Think again?

[From [url=https://occultlily.itch.io/zeitz-machz-rhapsody]itch.io[/url]]
